title_sq: Ofrohet per shitje apartament i tipologjise 2+1 ne Astir.
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament i tipologjise 2+1 ne Astir.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet te ofron facilitete te shumta per nje jetese komode, te tilla si: akses te shpejte me rruget kryesore, furra, markete etj.
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje koridor shperndares, sallonin se bashku me kuzhinen nga ku aksesohet dhe ballkoni, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet.
Disponon certefikate pronesie.
Per nje vizite ne prone mos hezitoni te me kntaktoni.
title_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale in Astir.
description_en: A 2+1 apartment is offered for sale in Astir. The area in which it is located offers many facilities for a comfortable life, such as: quick access to the main roads, bakeries, markets, etc. The apartment is organized in a distribution corridor, the living room together with the kitchen from which the balcony is accessed, 2 bedrooms and a bathroom. It has ownership certificates. For a visit to the property, do not hesitate to contact me.
